correctness.rationale: The recursive complete rank-q type criterion is proved by the two-sided extension induction with full atomic diagrams. All sizes one through 32, including the sharp boundaries, were exhaustively recomputed with actual packaged verifier and certificate; rotation reduction is a genuine automorphism. For every size at least 32 the cyclic-arc gap-splitting invariant gives a Duplicator win in five rounds, closing the infinite tail. Critical scope: one directed cycle, relational rather than functional successor; the finite program alone is not claimed as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Directed single cycles are canonical connected models of bijection relations; exact rank-equivalence cutoffs quantify finite logical locality and the smallest model needed for each initial-depth type. The five consecutive thresholds are a natural complete initial profile, not a selected arbitrary instance. The fifth-rank cutoff 19 sharpens the general sufficient size 32 by 13 and gives reusable explicit benchmarks. No downstream theorem beyond this invariant is claimed.
